configuration.selection_rule: lowest pooled validation MAE; test scores were not consulted
configuration.availability_note: station_met and merra are retrospective-only groups. Their results are retrospective estimations, not operational forecasts. The ground-only group set is the only one that satisfies the operational feature contract.

feature_groups.name: aod
feature_groups.description: INSAT-3D aerosol optical depth in the station collocation window, together with the number of valid pixels supporting it and the number of overpasses averaged into the daily value. The support columns are included because the pixel count is the only available proxy for retrieval quality: the granules carry no QA or cloud-flag dataset.
feature_groups.note: Enabled after the Phase 4 validation, which verified the extraction against every granule: uniform structure, the HDF5 dimension-scale orientation corroborated independently by the ocean-versus-land aerosol contrast, fill value -999.0, no duplicate date-overpass keys, and collocation-window sensitivity reported. Retrospective only: the observation is for a past date and the publication latency is not established, and no satellite forecast product exists in the repository.

metadata.known_limitation: The granules carry no QA or cloud-flag dataset, so a present pixel means a retrieval was attempted, not that the retrieval is trustworthy.

feature_groups.name: calendar
feature_groups.description: Cyclic encodings of day-of-week and month, preserving the circular topology of the weekly and annual cycles.

feature_groups.name: merra
feature_groups.description: MERRA-2 reanalysis at the station grid cell, averaged over the three hourly timesteps (11:30, 12:30, 13:30 UTC) that the distributed granules contain.
feature_groups.note: RETROSPECTIVE ONLY, and never operational. Reanalysis is not available at forecast issue time: it is an assimilation product for a past period, not a forecast of a future one. The feature names carry the '_midday' suffix because the granules contain a midday window, not a daily mean.

feature_groups.name: pm25_history
feature_groups.description: Calendar-aware PM2.5 history: lags at 1, 2, 3 and 7 calendar days and 3- and 7-day rolling means, all computed from strictly prior calendar days.

feature_groups.name: station_met
feature_groups.description: CPCB station-local meteorological measurements, daily aggregated from the hourly export: air temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and direction, rainfall, cumulative rainfall, solar radiation and vertical wind speed. The barometric pressure column is excluded: it fails the Phase 5 physical cross-validation against MERRA-2.
feature_groups.note: RETROSPECTIVE ONLY. The Phase 3 Workstream D audit confirmed these are genuine hourly station-local measurements (zero identical values against MERRA-2 across 516 matched hours), but the CPCB export carries no publication or upload timestamp, so the time at which each value became available to a forecaster cannot be established. No publication lag is assumed. Excluded from every operational feature contract. The barometric pressure column BP is excluded from this group because the Phase 5 cross-validation found daily means up to 1062 mmHg (1416 hPa, above sea-level pressure at sea level) on 107 days, anti-correlation with the MERRA-2 surface pressure at the same site, and a diurnal maximum at 10h rather than near dawn.

availability_contract.merra: retrospective only - reanalysis is never operational
